data.name: Katrielle
data.gender_notes: Katrielle is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name 'Katherine' meaning 'pure' or 'refined'. In the New Testament, St. Catherine of Alexandria is revered for her faith and wisdom, making this name popular among Christians. The name Katrielle carries the meaning “Pure, Refined” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Katrielle usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, refined and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes purity and refinement, both in character and spirit.
data.etymology: Katrielle belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure, Refined.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Katrielle total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: קטריאל
in_hebrew.meaning: קטריאל הוא שם שמשמעותו טוהר וקדושה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: קטריאל הוא שם שמשמעותו טוהר וקדושה, נגזר מהשורש ק-ט-ר שפירושו לטהר ולהקדיש. השם קטריאל מופיע בתנ"ך ככינויו של מלאך או של דמות רוחנית שפועלת לטובת בני האדם. השם משקף את האידיאל של טוהר וקדושה הנדרש מבני האדם.

in_greek.name: Κατριέλλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Κατριέλλ σημαίνει καθαρότητα και αγιότητα, προέρχονται από την εβραϊκή ρίζα ק-ט-ר που σημαίνει καθαρίζω και αγιάζω. Το όνομα Κατριέλλ απαντάται στην Καινή Διαθήκη ως προσωνύμιο αγγέλου ή πνευματικού προσώπου που δρα για το καλό των ανθρώπων. Το όνομα αντανακλά το ιδανικό της καθαρότητας και αγιότητας που απαιτείται από τους ανθρώπους.

in_latin.name: Katrielle
in_latin.long_meaning: Katrielle means purity and holiness, derived from the Hebrew root ק-ט-ר which means to purify and sanctify. The name Katrielle appears in the Bible as a nickname for an angel or spiritual being who acts for the benefit of humanity. The name reflects the ideal of purity and holiness required of human beings.

in_english.name: Katrielle
in_english.meaning: Katrielle signifies purity, holiness, and divine dedication
in_english.long_meaning: Katrielle signifies purity, holiness, and divine dedication, originating from the Hebrew root ק-ט-ר (q-t-r) meaning 'to purify' and 'to sanctify'. Although not directly mentioned in the Bible, the name's etymology links to biblical concepts of spiritual cleansing and devotion. Historically, names with similar roots have been used in Christian traditions to denote a connection to divine service. The name Katrielle embodies virtues of spiritual purity and commitment, resonating with Christian values of holiness and righteousness.
